data.name: ACME - Outbound to newly-seen external destination
data.description: Outbound connection from an enriched Acme Edge asset to an external destination not seen in the prior baseline. MITRE ATT&CK: Command and Control / T1071.

scheduledParams.query: dataSource.name = 'Acme Edge' dst_ip = * !(net_rfc1918(dst_ip)) | group hits = count(), dst_ports = estimate_distinct(dst_port), last_seen = newest(timestamp) by src_ip, dst_ip | filter hits >= 1 | lookup device_host = device_host, device_agentid = device_agentid, device_os = device_os, device_criticality = device_criticality from acmeEndpointByIp by device_ip = src_ip | columns hits, dst_ports, last_seen, src_ip, dst_ip, device_agentid, device_host, device_os, device_criticality | sort -hits | limit 100
